mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sa_quiz_answer (quiz_id, question_id, user_id, user_answer_json, is_correct) VALUES (#{quizId}, #{questionId}, #{userId}, #{userAnswerJson}, #{isCorrect})
mapper.select: SELECT id, quiz_id, question_id, user_id, user_answer_json, is_correct FROM sa_quiz_answer WHERE quiz_id = #{quizId} AND user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY id ASC
